matrix_direction: GFX100RF camera-native linear RGB to X2D 100C camera-native linear RGB
method: Estimate CCT from the selected Fuji neutral while interpolating the GFX100RF Illuminant-A and D65 ColorMatrix values in reciprocal-temperature space; reconstruct the XYZ white, predict the X2D neutral with C_X2D_D65, and apply only the positive per-channel diagonal that maps the Fuji neutral to that target neutral.

sources.gfx100rf_a_d65: Installed Adobe Lightroom Classic Adobe Standard DCP, independently read from ColorMatrix1/2 and CalibrationIlluminant1/2

limitations: X2D public characterization supplies D65 only, so the target matrix is not dual-illuminant
CCT estimation is bounded to Standard Light A through D65 and uses McCamy only as an interpolation selector
No matched GFX100RF/X2D chart captures are available
The positive diagonal intentionally repairs white-point alignment only; it does not perform a full cross-channel color correction
This repairs the known WB-domain mismatch but does not establish final HNCS color equivalence
